title: KFUM Uppsala claim Superettan title
description: KFUM Uppsala - Hogsbo 75-67 KFUM Uppsala clinched Superettan title. They beat Hogsbo in the decider. The best player for the winners was guard Ludvig Friberg (185-2000) who scored 21 points and 8 rebounds. Naturalized Greek point guard Mannos Nakos (179-1988) chipped in 17 points and 5 assists. Four KFUM Uppsala players scored in double figures. At the other side the best for losing team was Croatian power forward Tony Vitali (203-1991) who recorded a double-double by scoring 21 points and 13 rebounds and forward Filip Sjostrom (200-1990) added 11 points and 7 rebounds respectively. Hogsbo's coach rotated eleven players in this game, but that didn't help.
